page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ae.large is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at 3.4 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it features 2 vCPUs mapped to a single physical core with 2 threads per core. The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB per core, and does not include local storage or a GPU. Network connectivity is supported by a 3 Gbps baseline bandwidth under a KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark results indicate a strong single-core performance profile, with stress-ng single-core CPU and Geekbench single-core scores ranking in the top 25%. However, multi-core and parallel processing capabilities are limited, as evidenced by weak multi-core scores in both stress-ng and Geekbench. Memory performance is mixed; while large-block read and write bandwidths fall in the average range, small-block cached read bandwidth is poor, placing in the bottom 10%. Cryptographic and vector instruction sets like AES, VAES, SHA_NI, and AVX-512 are present, though passmark CPU encryption and physics tests register in the lower 25%.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g8ae.large offers a balanced entry-level resource profile for workloads that prioritize single-threaded execution over highly parallelized tasks. Due to poor performance in database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput, this instance is less suited for high-traffic web servers or intensive database hosting. It is best utilized for lightweight general-purpose applications, single-threaded background jobs, text processing, and basic development or testing environments.
